sections.kicker: Prepared for Pine Coffee Supply by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Pine promises fun in the bio. The grid delivers calm, and the best idea sits in a caption.
sections.keep: The art card that ships with each coffee, a landscape from the Wind River country with a tasting chart on the back.

meet first.

pins.what: The promise is fun. The grid shows hushed landscapes and still life.
pins.why: Fun is the one word that separates Pine from the next specialty roaster, and nothing on the grid shows it.
pins.how: Show the fun in one repeatable gesture.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The word fun reads as a line, not a trait.

pins.quote: The art card captures the continental divide in Colorado.
pins.what: Your most ownable idea shows up as a side note.
pins.why: A landscape card with every coffee ties each bag to a place, and no other roaster has this.
pins.how: Make the card the hero of every coffee launch.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The one thing a competitor cannot copy sounds like packaging.

pins.quote: tasting notes of peach rings, strawberry, and brown sugar
pins.what: Coffees are named by number, the memorable part is in the caption.
pins.why: Nobody recommends FUN 16 to a friend. They recommend the one that tastes like peach rings.
pins.how: Let the tasting note be the name people use.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: Regulars cannot pass your coffees by word of mouth.
